Checkout writes are idempotent and all payment callbacks use an explicit transaction boundary.
Production changes require an observable rollback command and a dashboard link.
External API contracts are versioned and backward compatible for one deprecation window.
Database migrations are expand/contract and never combine destructive steps with deploys.
Security-sensitive changes require threat-model notes in the review record.
Every asynchronous consumer is safe to retry and records a correlation id.
Tenant-scoped queries must include the tenant predicate at the repository boundary.
New endpoints expose latency and error-rate metrics before production rollout.
